annotations.exact_quote: This paper presents CSOT, namely Common Semantics via Optimal Transport, to boost contrastive multi-view clustering via semantic learning in a common space that integrates all views.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文提出通过对比学习进行多视图聚类并在公共空间学习语义表示，学习可学习表示以完成聚类划分，符合深度聚类。

annotations.exact_quote: which improves the effectiveness of cross-view contrastive representation learning
annotations.reason_zh: 论文显式采用跨视图对比表示学习，并以吸引/区分式对比目标改善表示，符合对比学习定义。

annotations.exact_quote: Through optimal transport, the samples in multiple views are mapped to the joint clusters which represent the multi-view semantic patterns in the common space.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文处理同一对象的多视图数据并显式联合利用视图间关系学习公共语义模式，属于多视图学习。

annotations.exact_quote: With the semantic assignment derived from the optimal transport plan, we design a semantic learning module where the soft assignment vector works as a global supervision to enforce the model to learn consistent semantics among all views.
annotations.reason_zh: 将从最优传输方案得到的软分配作为全局监督信号指导模型后续学习，符合伪标签/自训练中把预测分配用作训练信号的机制。
